messages:
rachel: Quick sync on marketplace private-offer for HW+platform. Need clear pricing lanes, SI incentives, and a renewal conversion path. Short thread please.

marco: Customer wants a 12mo commit with a 2-month ramp. Can we do a tiered private offer that maps to marketplace SKUs?

deepa: Recommend explicit tiers to avoid ambiguous wording in listing. Example: Tiers: 80k, 240k, 480k. Discounts: 18%, 26%, 36%. Include a 30% monthly floor for early months.

felix: Ops note: most marketplaces only accept static price fields. If we need ramping, we either submit separate SKUs (onramp SKU + steady SKU) or encode ramp as PO PDF. Ops prefers separate SKUs.

rachel: SI incentives: propose $12k onboarding credit (invoice-applied) + $4k success payout after go-live. Cap credits to first 3 deals per SI in first 6 months.

marco: Finance okay with credits if capped. Also want an automatic mid-term conversion: if customer sustains >=110% of floor for two months, allow retro upgrade and credit difference.

deepa: Legal redline: credits non-transferable, expire 180 days, and are applied only to invoices. Renewal fallback: unused credits may convert to a one-time renewal discount if customer opts into renewal within 60 days.

partner-bot: ticket_created: "Marketplace SKU mapping - HW-PLATFORM-BUNDLE" Ticket #66022. Assignees: felix, ops. Due: 2024-10-03.

felix: Action items:
- felix: confirm SKU creation workflow and whether we need two SKUs by 2024-09-25
- deepa: draft SI credit T&Cs by 2024-09-20
- marco: provide pilot customer list and estimated commit volumes by 2024-09-18
- rachel: prepare co-announce assets and sample buyer-facing wording by 2024-09-28

rachel: One more: fallback pricing for under-delivery after 45-day grace. Proposal: post-commit consumption adjustment at the agreed tier rate (presented as adjustment, not fee), or offer a pro-rated downgrade. Use plain language in buyer docs.

deepa: Legal prefers "post-commit consumption adjustment" in outward docs. I'll add worked examples in the PO addendum.

marco: Sounds good. I'll loop field ops and sales. Thanks team :raised_hands:
